pr_body:
Users should be able to specify specific metrics/keys within a specific bucket key. 

An example is `agg["bucket_foo"]._count`. 

This change now allows that.

closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/76320
pr_title: Allow bucket paths to specify _count within a bucket
pr_comment: Hi @benwtrent, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: Unrelated to this PR, but `AggregationExecutionException` is the wrong thing to throw here.  That's a 500 class error, but this is a user error that should not be retried, which is what 400 class is for.  I opened https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/86273 to try to not lose track of it.
Let's leave these reasons as comments then?  It may not be immediately obvious why some of these are wrong.
These examples should probably also land in the user facing docs
